checks.label: e is a fixed constant like π and always equals approximately 2.71828: the e on this page is 2.71828 to five decimals, the number line marks it as e ≈ 2.718, and 8,760 parts come within 0.0002 of it

Under simple interest alone the money doubles during the period, and under continually compounding interest it is multiplied by e: paid as one part the pot ends the year at twice its start, and every never-pausing curve at the full rate ends each year at e times where it began
The rate of growth is proportional to the current function value: on the slope tracker, at every point tried, the slope measured on eˣ equals its height, and both read the same

Every staircase follows its rule: after j of the year's n parts the pot is 100 × (1 + 1/n)ʲ, each rise is bigger than the one before, and with more parts the year's end comes closer to the smooth curve

The year's total grows with every extra split, by less each time, and stays below e: the table writes it as 2, 2.25, 2.4414, 2.6130, 2.7146 and 2.7181, and the model returns it, with the pot, at every setting of the parts

Every number follows its rule: £200, £150, £75 and £225; £244.14 (slips £200 and £1,600); £261.30, £271.46 and £271.81, 36p more than 365 parts; 1.6487, £164.87 and 7.389; £738.91 (slips £400 and £543.66); 1.05, 1.0512 and 1.0513 at 5%, and 2,000 parts; 0.368, 0.135 and 0.050; 147 V (slips 0 V and 1,087 V); 1.35 (slips 1.331 and 1.3); £1,061.84 and £1,061.68 (slips £1,060 and £163.10); and each answer offered is the value its own working gives
A smaller rate settles the same way: at every rate from 1% to 100%, 1, 12 and 365 parts give totals that rise towards eᵏ without passing it, and every bar is drawn to one scale
With a minus in the power each equal step multiplies by the same 0.368: the marks at 1, 2 and 3 read 0.368, 0.135 and 0.050, each e^(−1) times the one before
Before an answer, nothing in a puzzle's picture gives it away, and a right answer shows it
Each puzzle offers three answers and takes only its right one, and every wrong answer has a hint of its own
Every demonstration has finished arriving within its time (at most 4.5 s), none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion, right or wrong, within 2.5 s
